correctness.rationale: Rank-one symmetry gives A=c uu^T and A^2=0 iff u.u=0. The rank-one commutator identity shows pairwise commutation iff image vectors pairwise orthogonal, including collinear and characteristic-two cases. Subspace-lattice Möbius inversion yields the complete tuple count. The characteristic-two radical decomposition and Witt signs give every polar coefficient; the parity identity is established by an explicit Gaussian product calculation. The geometric incidence construction has an irreducible fiber over each isotropic-Grassmannian component, all smaller image spans degenerate from the maximal open stratum, and the only disconnected isotropic-Grassmannian case is the even-dimensional odd-characteristic maximal one. Eleven independent matrix-product finite enumerations pass; finite tests are supportive and not the general proof.
